_note: commitment-in-plain-words — a toezegging is a commitment. Every organisation whose officers answer to a body has them: a portfolio holder promises the council a memo, a director promises the works council a figure, a board member promises the ALV a report. The properties were already in plain words. Only the schema was not.

Commitment.title: Commitment
Commitment.description: A commitment somebody made to a governance body in a meeting, tracked from the moment it is made through to settlement. A portfolio holder promises the council a memo; a director promises the works council a figure; a board member promises the ALV a report. Renamed from Toezegging (commitment-in-plain-words): every organisation whose officers answer to a body has these, and only the word was Dutch. Every property keeps its name. The slug is `governance-commitment` rather than `commitment`, which shillinq owns: schema slugs are GLOBAL on a shared OpenRegister.

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: Declarative guarded transition map (ADR-031, REQ-002). Canonical dialect verbatim from the Decision schema (keyword 'initial', never 'initialState'/'default'). open → in-uitvoering → afgedaan | vervallen; afgedaan and vervallen terminal. Afdoening (afgedaan) always passes through in-uitvoering; a not-yet-started commitment may lapse directly (open → vervallen). No app-side state machine.

toezeggingRappelBeforeDeadline._note: Pre-deadline rappel (REQ-004). intervalSec 1209600 (~14 days) is PROVISIONAL (design open question — griffie-configurable tuning deferred). Filter targets non-terminal lifecycle only; the 'deadline within window' vs 'deadline past' distinction is carried by the scheduled engine's window semantics, which the simple filter shape shown for Meeting cannot express as a deadline comparison — verify OR's scheduled-notification engine interprets these two triggers as before/after-deadline rappels during live import.

toezeggingRappelOverdue._note: Overdue rappel (REQ-004). intervalSec 604800 (weekly) is PROVISIONAL. Filters non-terminal lifecycle so no notification fires for afgedaan/vervallen. Same window-semantics caveat as toezeggingRappelBeforeDeadline. Recipients approximate 'madeBy + griffie' via object-acl (read) + decidesk-members group, because no recipient kind targets the madeBy Person reference directly.

text.title: Commitment
text.description: The commitment itself (what was promised, by whom, on what).
text.example: Wethouder Van Dijk zegt toe de raad vóór 1 maart per raadsbrief te informeren over de wachtlijsten jeugdzorg.

madeBy.title: Made by
madeBy.description: Reference to the portefeuillehouder / college member who made the commitment (schema:Action agent). Required.

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.description: Reference to the Meeting in which the commitment was made. Required.

agendaItem.title: Agenda item
agendaItem.description: Reference to the AgendaItem the commitment relates to. Optional.

directedTo.title: Directed to
directedTo.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody the commitment is directed to (council/committee). Required.

deadline.title: Deadline
deadline.description: Date by which the commitment should be settled. Optional; drives the declarative rappels and the overdue dashboard KPI.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Commitment status (declared in x-openregister-lifecycle, ADR-031): open → in-uitvoering → afgedaan | vervallen. afgedaan and vervallen are terminal. Marking afgedaan SHOULD carry an afdoeningsToelichting.

settlementNotes.title: Afdoening note
settlementNotes.description: Note explaining how the commitment was settled (recorded when moving to afgedaan). Optional.

settlementEvidence.title: Afdoening evidence
settlementEvidence.description: Link or reference to evidence of afdoening (e.g. the raadsbrief). Optional. A plain URL/reference string: not a UID field, so the object stays fully publishable (design D4).

relatedMotion.title: Related motion
relatedMotion.description: Optional reference to a Decision of decisionType 'motion' this commitment stems from. When set, the execution narrative lives ONLY on that motion's UitvoeringsUpdate log (motie-amendement-administratie); this register creates no second execution-update log (REQ-003).

goal.title: Goal
goal.description: Optional reference to the organisation Goal (organisation-goals change) this commitment serves. When set, this commitment is counted in that Goal's declarative linkedCommitmentCount/settledCommitmentCount rollup (organisation-goals REQ-006). Nullable; existing toezeggingen created before this change remain valid with no goal set.

publicationDate.title: Publication date
publicationDate.description: Publication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set in the past, the live toezegging is anonymously readable through the OpenRegister published-predicate (public-group authorization.read rule publicationDate <= $now). Publish is an explicit staff action; because the predicate sits on the live object the public list reflects lifecycle changes without republication (REQ-005 / design D4).

depublicationDate.title: Depublication date
depublicationDate.description: Depublication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set and in the past, the toezegging is withdrawn from public access. Set by staff on withdraw.

migratedFromObject.title: Migrated from
migratedFromObject.description: The identifier of the retired record this one was copied from. Set only by the fold migration; absent on seeds and on anything a person created.

Toezegging.description: SUPERSEDED (commitment-in-plain-words): the same thing as Commitment (slug governance-commitment). Every property keeps its name; only the schema does not. Definition and slug are kept (hardDelete:false, existing rows).

Raadsinformatiebrief.description: Repointed by commitment-in-plain-words: `settledCommitment` now references governance-commitment, because Toezegging is retired.

settledCommitment.title: Settled commitment
settledCommitment.description: The commitment this letter settles, when it settles one.

TermijnagendaItem.description: Repointed by commitment-in-plain-words: `commitment` now references governance-commitment, because Toezegging is retired.

originCommitment.title: Origin commitment
originCommitment.description: The commitment this planned item follows up, when it follows one.
